enrollment_submitted.subject: We received your enrollment in {course}
enrollment_submitted.p1: Hi {name}: we registered your enrollment request for {course} ({classGroup}) and we already have your {amount} receipt.
enrollment_submitted.p2: We are checking it now. We will write again as soon as we are done — there is nothing to send twice.

payment_under_review.subject: Your receipt is under review
payment_under_review.p1: Hi {name}: someone on the team is reviewing the receipt you sent for {course}. This is a normal step when the image is hard to read.
payment_under_review.p2: Your seat in {classGroup} stays reserved in the meantime.

payment_approved.subject: Your payment was approved: your seat in {course} is confirmed
payment_approved.p1: Hi {name}: we approved your {amount} payment and your seat in {classGroup} is confirmed.
payment_approved.p2: Classes start on {date}. A few days before, the virtual classroom access reaches this same address.

payment_rejected.subject: We could not validate your receipt
payment_rejected.p1: Hi {name}: we reviewed the receipt you sent for {course} and could not validate it.
payment_rejected.p2: Message us on WhatsApp and we will sort it out with you. Keep your operation number at hand.

credentials_issued.subject: Your student portal credentials
credentials_issued.p1: Hi {name}: you can now sign in to the portal with the e-mail you enrolled with. Your course, your schedule and your documents are there.
credentials_issued.p2: The first time, we will ask you to set a new password. Do not share this e-mail with anyone.

guardian_consent_reminder.subject: Your consent is missing for {name}’s enrollment
guardian_consent_reminder.p1: Hi {guardian}: {name} enrolled in {course} and, being a minor, we need your consent to process their data (Ley 29733).
guardian_consent_reminder.p2: It is a one-minute form. Without it we cannot complete the enrollment.

seat_reservation_expiring.subject: Your seat in {course} expires tomorrow
seat_reservation_expiring.p1: Hi {name}: we are holding your seat in {classGroup} while your payment is confirmed, and the deadline is tomorrow.
seat_reservation_expiring.p2: If you already paid, send us your operation number on WhatsApp and we will review it today.

class_access_ready.subject: Your {course} virtual classroom is ready
class_access_ready.p1: Hi {name}: your class group {classGroup} starts on {date}. You can sign in with the e-mail you enrolled with.
class_access_ready.p2: Every class is live and in a group, at your class group’s time. Make sure your inbox has room left.

enrollment_certificate_issued.subject: Your enrollment certificate is ready
enrollment_certificate_issued.p1: Hi {name}: we issued your enrollment certificate for {course}. It is attached to this e-mail and also waiting in your portal.
enrollment_certificate_issued.p2: The document carries a verification code: anyone can check it is genuine on our page.

certificate_issued.subject: Your {course} certificate is ready
certificate_issued.p1: Hi {name}: congratulations on finishing {course}. Your completion certificate has been issued and is attached to this e-mail.
certificate_issued.p2: It is also kept in your portal, with its verification code.

teacher_credentials_issued.subject: Your access to the Only One Coin panel
teacher_credentials_issued.p1: Hi {name}: we created your panel account. You sign in with this same address, and your class groups, students and pending grades are there.
teacher_credentials_issued.p2: The first time, we will ask you to set a new password. Do not share this e-mail with anyone.

teacher_class_group_assigned.subject: You have a new class group: {classGroup}
teacher_class_group_assigned.p1: Hi {name}: the class group {classGroup} of {course} is yours now. It starts on {date}.
teacher_class_group_assigned.p2: The panel has the student list, the schedule and the virtual classroom link.

teacher_contract_expiring.subject: Your contract ends soon
teacher_contract_expiring.p1: Hi {name}: your contract with the Asociación ends on {date}. We are telling you early so it can be renewed before the next cycle starts.
teacher_contract_expiring.p2: Coordination will reach out about signing. If you already discussed it, ignore this e-mail.

teacher_grades_pending.subject: Grades are still missing in {classGroup}
teacher_grades_pending.p1: Hi {name}: the cycle of {classGroup} has closed and grades of yours are still missing.
teacher_grades_pending.p2: Without them we cannot issue those students’ certificates.

staff_certificates_ready.subject: {classGroup} is ready for its certificates
staff_certificates_ready.p1: Hi {name}: {classGroup} has finished and the list of who meets the requirements is prepared.
staff_certificates_ready.p2: Nothing is issued on its own: you review it and confirm.

emails.title: Emails
emails.locked_title: This section belongs to administration and coordination
emails.locked_body: The automatic e-mails decide what every student receives as their enrollment moves. Your role does not manage them.
emails.stat_paused_hint: {count, plural, =0 {Every e-mail is switched on} one {One e-mail is off: nobody receives it} other {# e-mails are off: nobody receives them}}
emails.empty_body: Try other words, or drop the paused filter.
emails.preview_note: This is the versioned template from the repository, rendered with sample data. Each person receives it in their own language.
emails.state_hint_on: It goes out on its own, as soon as what triggers it happens.
emails.state_hint_off: It is paused: nobody receives it, not even the person waiting for it.
emails.no_send_notice: There is no per-student send button: every e-mail goes out as a consequence of something that happened in the system, and a resend is an audited exception.
emails.test_hint: Up to {max} addresses. The subject goes out prefixed with {prefix}.
emails.test_guard: Outside production the provider only accepts addresses on the allowlist.
emails.test_error_invalid: This does not look like an address.

emails.journey_empty: No e-mail goes out at this point yet.
emails.help_condition: The grey label is the condition: that e-mail only goes out when the case takes that turn.
emails.help_guardian: Guardian: they receive it, not the student.
emails.help_paused: Paused: that e-mail is switched off, and nobody receives anything at that point.
emails.help_open: Every box opens the e-mail, with its template.
emails.test_error_duplicate: That address is already on the list.

new_email.title: New send
new_email.recipients_count: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody matches this group} one {One person} other {# people}}
new_email.recipients_note: The group is resolved at send time, against the register: it is never stored at the provider. Anyone who asked not to receive notices is left out (Ley 29733).
new_email.subject_placeholder: What is read in the inbox
new_email.content_note: It goes out in the language you write it in: a hand-written notice does not translate itself. The automatic ones do reach each person in their own.
new_email.test_note: Send a test before approving. If you change the subject, the message or the file afterwards, the test stops counting and has to be repeated.
new_email.test_ok: Test sent, and the content has not changed since.
new_email.confirm_label: I read the text and confirm the group is the right one.
new_email.double_approval: A send to everyone needs a second approval from administration. This screen does not simulate it yet.
new_email.cooldown_note: The same group receives no other notice for the next 7 days.
new_email.audit_note: The send goes to the audit log: who approved it, to which group, and with what text.
new_email.sent_body: {count, plural, one {It goes to one person.} other {It goes to # people.}} The queue delivers it; nothing leaves from this screen.
new_email.search_class_group: Search the class group by code or course
new_email.html_note: It goes out as it is: images have to be absolute links, and no e-mail runs scripts.
new_email.html_error_type: It has to be an .html file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.locked_body: This is where the grade that decides who is certified and the tolerance the platform approves a receipt with, unseen, are set. Only whoever administers the platform changes them.
settings.passing_grade_hint: 0–20 scale. Below this no certificate is issued.
settings.certificate_deadline_hint: Business days from the end of the class group to issue the free certificate.
settings.constancia_fee_hint: The constancia is a paid procedure: the student pays, uploads the receipt, and only then is it issued.
settings.contract_alert_hint: How many days before the end the panel marks a teacher's contract as expiring.
settings.academic_notice: Changing a number applies from here on: it never revisits what was already issued or revalidates a closed grade.
settings.tolerance_hint: How far a receipt may fall from the plan price and still pass on its own.
settings.confidence_hint: Below this value on a critical field the receipt is escalated instead of approved.
settings.reservation_hint: Days a seat stays reserved with no approved payment. After that it is released.
settings.checkout_hold_hint: Minutes the public enrolment holds a seat while the student goes off to pay. When it runs out the seat goes back to the class group and they pick a schedule again.
settings.receipts_notice: Changing a parameter applies to receipts arriving afterwards: it never revalidates a payment already settled.
settings.saved_toast: Changes applied on screen only. No server is connected yet.

features.locked_body: This is where it is decided which parts of the platform exist in production. That is a call for whoever runs the platform, not for whoever administers the school, so only accounts on the owners’ domain open it.

source.environment: On because this is not the production environment.

features.hidden_by_parent: On, but nobody sees it: the section that holds it is off.
features.parent_off: Off: {count, plural, one {the # section below is} other {the # sections below are}} seen by nobody, whatever their own switches say.
features.not_production: This is the “{env}” environment, not production: whatever nobody turns off here shows up on, always. A switch moved on this screen does count for this environment.
features.internal_unlock: Your browser is carrying the internal unlock: you see everything on, including what is off for everyone else.
features.footnote: Turning a section off takes it out of production: it leaves the menu and its address answers 404. It stays whole for us — local, the preview deploys and, in production, for whoever opens the internal unlock. This is not access control: who may do what is still the cargo. Every change is recorded.
features.reset_done: Back to what the code says.
features.write_failed: The change could not be saved.
features.confirm_off_body: Every address under {surface} will answer 404 for everyone but us the moment you confirm — {count, plural, =0 {nothing else rides on it} one {the # section below included} other {all # sections below included}}.

not_found.title: Nothing here
not_found.body: Either this section is off in production right now, the link is old, or whatever it pointed to no longer exists.
